features.name: Panattoni Park Swindon
features.official_source_evidence: Panattoni UK is retained as the primary developer source for the South Marston redevelopment. A current exact project or unit page must be captured before production publication.
features.classification_finding: Panattoni Park Swindon is a multi-building industrial and logistics redevelopment, not one Industrial Unit. A named unit or warehouse must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: 10 Brock Street / Regent's Place
features.official_source_evidence: Regent's Place is the official estate identity. Authoritative building records identify 10 Brock Street at 338 Euston Road as a sixteen-storey office building commissioned within the British Land estate.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is supported. The individual 10 Brock Street footprint must remain separate from the wider mixed-use Regent's Place estate.

features.name: Sutton House and Breaker's Yard
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Sutton House as a Tudor house at 2 and 4 Homerton High Street, Hackney, London E9 6JQ and records its original family-home history.
features.classification_finding: The standalone-house identity is strong, but current visitor and community use requires a taxonomy decision before preserving Detached Home as a production residential type.

features.name: Manchester Arndale

features.name: 10 Upper Bank Street

features.classification_finding: Office Building is supported. Current tenant changes do not alter the principal building type; exact tower footprint evidence remains pending.

features.name: Chastleton House
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Chastleton House as a historic house and visitor property in Oxfordshire.
features.classification_finding: Standalone historic-house identity is supported, but present heritage use requires a documented taxonomy decision before treating the asset as an ordinary Detached Home.
